law: Grammars are frozen by geometry, not by model name. A grammar is promoted only on a same-model before/after with parity held.

candidates.note: must be reproduced live before promotion; the campaign requires it
HAWKING_GLM_GPU_LM_HEAD implemented and parity-tested, never throughput-measured

candidates.blocker: gemm_q4_k_m_batched_v3w_pinned_tcb caps B at 8 (two float4 accumulators)
candidates.prize: 15.8x versus llama.cpp on the identical file, the largest measured gap in this campaign
candidates.finding: a true tiled GEMM already exists: gemm_q4_k_m_batched_v3w_mma uses simdgroup_matrix<float,8,8>. The ceiling is not the primitive, it is that the kernel computes exactly one 8x8 output tile with N zero-padded to 8.
candidates.the_change: tile over N as well as rows: accumulate ceil(N/8) column tiles against the same resident weight tile, instead of one
candidates.why_it_works: Ws does not grow with N. One weight read is amortized across N activations rather than 8, which is the entire prefill deficit.
candidates.limit: Apple threadgroup memory is 32 KB, so N=128 fits with headroom; N is bounded by shmem, not by the MMA primitive
candidates.why_rust_level_chunking_does_not_work: looping the existing kernel over N-chunks of 8 re-reads the weight tile per chunk, which is exactly what B_MAX=8 already does, so it yields nothing
candidates.already_threaded: HAWKING_QWEN_PREFILL_BATCH reaches both the prefill loop and the arena, clamped to 8; the clamp is the only thing to lift once the kernel accepts more

k0_finding: 63-77% of the token is fixed cost, not weight bandwidth. Stages that move bytes are low value on this geometry; stages that remove per-token work are high value.
